issue.title: Update dependency next to v9

repository.name: topics-manager
repository.description: Serverless App to manage GitHub repos' topics

issue.body:
This PR contains the following updates:

| Package | Type | Update | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| [next](https://nextjs.org) ([source](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js)) | dependencies | major | [`8.1.0` -> `9.0.2`](https://renovatebot.com/diffs/npm/next/8.1.0/9.0.2) |

---

### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>zeit/next.js</summary>

### [`v9.0.2`](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/releases/v9.0.2)

[Compare Source](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/compare/v9.0.1...v9.0.2)

##### Patches

-   Remove duplicated client code: [#​7907](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7907)
-   Update docs for AMP export behavior: [#​7940](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7940)
-   Prevent blocking while hidden: [#​7930](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7930)
-   Added example for rbx and bulma-pro: [#​7728](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7728)
-   Checks if object is not empty instead of whether the reference (object) is truthy: [#​7911](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7911)
-   Replace windows backslashes with forward: [#​7942](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7942)
-   Update link ref handling to clean up previous listeners: [#​7943](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7943)
-   [Enhancement]: Refactor circleCI config: [#​7963](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7963)
-   Check if dynamicOptions has the deprecated `method` property,: [#​7973](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7973)
-   Don&[#​39](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/39);t externalize ssr-prepass if added by user: [#​7966](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7966)
-   Fix example with-firebase-hosting-and-typescript: [#​7971](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7971)
-   Fix: Ensure ergonomic handling of non-page in `./pages/`: [#​7955](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7955)
-   Example for API routes with middleware: [#​7958](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7958)
-   Add empty publicRuntimeConfig to serverless tests: [#​7948](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7948)
-   Add handling for invalid page config: [#​7921](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7921)
-   Fix client-side hydration with dynamic routes: [#​7986](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7986)
-   Fix GIP type in `/_error` page: [#​7952](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7952)
-   Only copy `public/` directory if enabled: [#​7988](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7988)
-   Add default value for pageConfig for custom \_error: [#​7984](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7984)
-   Fix build for API routes conflict pages: [#​7992](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7992)
-   Add warning for experimental config usage: [#​7985](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7985)
-   Add support for 412 Precondition Failed status for static files: [#​7944](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7944)
-   Feat(web): Passing actual status code instead 200: [#​7735](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7735)
-   Correct info about export limitations: [#​7729](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7729)
-   Add babel option to use styled-jsx/babel-test in the preset: [#​7747](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7747)
-   Don’t add loadable if it’s not used: [#​7995](https://togithub.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7995)

##### Credits

Huge thanks to [@​sudkumar](https://togithub.com/sudkumar), [@​mvllow](https://togithub.com/mvllow), [@​Restoration](https://togithub.com/Restoration), [@​adam187](https://togithub.com/adam187), [@​eperedo](https://togithub.com/eperedo), [@​jtomaszewski](https://togithub.com/jtomaszewski), [@​scythargon](https://togithub.com/scythargon), [@​4cm4k1](https://togithub.com/4cm4k1), [@​ijjk](https://togithub.com/ijjk), [@​nataliemarleny](https://togithub.com/nataliemarleny), [@​felixmosh](https://togithub.com/felixmosh), [@​yukin01](https://togithub.com/yukin01), and [@​huv1k](https://togithub.com/huv1k) for helping!

##### Credits
